bio: Meticulously prepared sea bass terrine, perfectly fried veal sweetbreads, koji butter (fermented on site) and a penchant for exotic flavours such as coconut milk and kombu – the culinary worlds of France and Asia meet at Fris. Classic techniques, top-of-the-range ingredients and playful originality bring the dishes to life. The non-alcoholic beverage accompaniments include delicious kombuchas made using kitchen scraps, among other things....
